confidence: Low to moderate about poisoning as a lead, low about identity. Opened cyanide bottle and death after toast supply a coherent method hypothesis, not yet a proven connection.
plausibility_notes: Opening damage after documented intact condition supplies physical evidence beyond introductory motives.
The locked cupboard does not establish who opened the bottle before it was stored; key access and the walkthrough attendees are missing.
Death after toast is temporal association; cause and the exact poisoned vessel remain unconfirmed.
An unsigned forced-resignation agreement makes Artie conspicuous early, but many access questions remain.
Historical cyanide survival is a theatrical convention that can be accepted in this scripted party.
